description: Anomalous deposits occurring just as the bank would be closing

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop-wire-fraud | WHERE account.event == "deposit" AND event.amount > 8000 | EVAL hour_of_day = DATE_EXTRACT("HOUR_OF_DAY", transaction.date), day_of_week = DATE_EXTRACT("DAY_OF_WEEK", transaction.date), amount_bucket = ROUND(event.amount / 500) * 500 | STATS deposit_count = COUNT(), unique_hours = COUNT_DISTINCT(hour_of_day), avg_amount = AVG(event.amount), hour_variance = VARIANCE(hour_of_day), std_dev_hour = STD_DEV(hour_of_day), most_common_hour = MEDIAN(hour_of_day), peak_hour_deposits = SUM(CASE(hour_of_day == 16, 1, 0)), total_amount = SUM(event.amount) BY account.name | WHERE deposit_count >= 5 | INLINE STATS avg_hour_variance = AVG(hour_variance), std_hour_variance = STD_DEV(hour_variance), avg_unique_hours = AVG(unique_hours), peak_hour_threshold = PERCENTILE(peak_hour_deposits, 90) | EVAL hour_consistency_score = CASE(hour_variance < 1.0, 4, hour_variance < 4.0, 3, hour_variance < 9.0, 2, 1), peak_hour_ratio = peak_hour_deposits / deposit_count, timing_suspicion = CASE(peak_hour_ratio > 0.7 AND hour_variance < 2.0, "CRITICAL", peak_hour_ratio > 0.5 AND hour_variance < 4.0, "HIGH", peak_hour_ratio > 0.3, "MODERATE", "LOW") | SORT hour_variance ASC, peak_hour_ratio DESC
